features.name: Fork update isolation
integrationEvidence: fast-gate update/release tests reached green after derivative adaptation
features.notes: No upstream StarNet update endpoint remains authoritative. This prevents accidental release-channel coupling while the private fork may continue to reuse compatible StarNet subsystems in-process.

features.name: Prefer compatible StarNet subsystem reuse
integrationEvidence: Existing orchestration, permissions, consent, E-STOP, providers, tools, memory, workflows, channels, MCP and UI foundations remain valid dependencies unless a Moe-specific requirement needs an extension.
features.notes: Moe AI Station is a private StarNet fork, not a clean-room replacement. Extend proven authoritative subsystems rather than duplicating them.

team.summon receives the same shared organizational class metadata without implicit capabilities
browser summon persistence writes orgRole and explicit parentAgentId
Moe AI Station CI and inherited gates passed on the integrated branch

features.name: Verified read-only Control Mode surfaces
integrationEvidence: six dedicated projections are GET/HEAD-only against existing authoritative runtime stores
E2E, schema, lifecycle and failure contracts verify fail-closed behavior
desktop and website surfaces are byte-mirrored
provider signals expose only registry metadata and observed quota/rate-limit evidence
features.notes: Observe-only Control Mode adds no parallel truth stores.

features.name: Private Google Workspace operator integration
integrationEvidence: Google connector contract exercises stable Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs and Sheets API paths through the real local transport adapter
Gmail contract verifies structured MIME draft composition, thread-safe sender reply drafts, reversible inbox/label changes, header/label validation and separate send authority
Drive contract verifies bounded text/Markdown/CSV/JSON artifact create/read/update paths, upload endpoint confinement and binary-read rejection
Calendar contract verifies create, patch, delete and read-then-patch self-attendee RSVP semantics
Docs and Sheets contracts verify simple document text append and table-row append in addition to the advanced batch APIs
host projection keeps Google connector mutations execute-scoped and consent-gated
features.notes: Gmail search/read/inbox-label management/structured-draft/reply-draft/send, Drive metadata/search/export plus bounded text artifact content IO, Calendar read/free-busy/event management, Docs read/create/append/edit and Sheets read/create/write/append/edit are implemented. Automated provider fixtures verify protocol behavior; a real private operator account remains an external acceptance step rather than fabricated CI evidence.

features.name: Derivative installer/update signing
features.notes: Not required for the private-use target. Reassess only if public distribution becomes a goal.

features.name: Complete derivative branding and artwork replacement
features.notes: Not required for private use. Redistribution remains outside project scope.

features.name: Safe app identity and data-path migration
features.notes: Do not force an identifier migration for private use; preserve compatible workspaces and credentials unless a functional requirement justifies a tested migration.
